name: Canadian Carnage
caption: The federation's own inaugural Tag Team Champions, managed by Sir John A. MacDonald IV.

tenures.source: The Tag Team Title Tournament final, 2 August 1995, served on this wing.
tenures.note: Won the inaugural SVW Tag Team Championship when their manager, Sir John A. MacDonald IV, pushed challenger Rich Seroch off the top rope, allowing a roll-up with a handful of tights.

name: The Privateers
caption: Runners-up for the inaugural SVW Tag Team Championship, pairing the federation's own reigning Heavyweight Champion with "Amazing" Rich Seroch.

tenures.source: The Tag Team Title Tournament (entered round 1) through its final, 2 August 1995, served on this wing.
tenures.note: Lost the Tag Team Title Tournament final to Canadian Carnage after a manager-assisted push from the top rope.

identity.note: Bare generic tag-team name match only against an existing, unrelated CSWA unit; no shared roster, operator, host, or date evidence links the two. Recorded as a collision, not merged.
